notes: Imports a PEPFAR MER Structured Dataset (tab-delimited site-level extract), subsets to TX_NEW / HTS_TST_POS / PMTCT* indicators, drops UID/geography columns and all-empty rows, exports the subset. The original infile pointed at an absolute Windows path; here it reads an inline tab-delimited sample built to the script's own informat/input schema (52 cols: 43 char + 9 FY numeric). The where/substr subset and empty-row delete logic are the author's, unchanged. proc export retargeted to a relative CSV. 23 rows in -> 17 after indicator filter -> 14 after empty-row delete.
